Subject: Intro call recap & next steps: Redwood for Greenfield Health

Hi Evelyn —

Great to speak with you and Samir today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive/demo: 

Key notes from discovery:
- Primary use: reduce NER and clinical note summarization latency for care coordination (p95 target < 500ms).
- Data sensitivity: PHI-adjacent; Greenfield prefers VPC/private deployments or strong encryption-at-rest and KMS integration.
- Volume: ~50M tokens/month currently, with bursty peaks during shift changes.
- Success metrics: latency, cost per 1k tokens, and end-to-end reliability during peak windows.

Suggested next step:
1) Technical deep dive + demo with your platform and security folks (45–60m). We can show live inference, KV cache behavior, and deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
2) Fill the mutual action plan so procurement has visibility; I attached a draft.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-09 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2026-03-09 15:00–16:00
- Wed 2026-03-10 09:00–10:00

If those don't work, happy to coordinate another slot. Could you please loop in your security lead and procurement contact? I'll add Monica (solutions engineer) and Dev (security architect) from our side.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft)

Thanks,
